text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At long last, the journey through the 
Twinkle Series alongside Seiun Sky was 
about to begin— ...or so it was supposed 
to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first day of training. For some 
reason, Seiun Sky invites her Trainer 
along to go early-morning sea fishing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reeling in a big catch to build momentum. 
Seiun Sky quips that in both fishing and 
racing, it's all about how you set your 
trap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An easygoing slacker, or a shrewd 
tactician? Thus began the days of chasing 
after that "big one" with an elusive, 
enigmatic girl.
